channel.title: Aera field notes
channel.description: What consumer wearables can and cannot measure, with the research behind each claim.

item.title: What is HRV?
item.description: Heart rate variability is the tiny change in spacing between beats, not how fast your heart goes. Yours only means something against your own nights.

item.title: What does a readiness score mean?
item.description: A training call from recent load, sleep debt, and overnight signals, not a health grade and not the same as one night of recovery.

item.title: Why is my resting heart rate up?
item.description: One high morning is usually noise. A run of mornings above your own range is the signal worth noticing.

item.title: How much sleep do I actually need?
item.description: There is no universal eight-hour rule. Sleep need is personal, and regularity often matters as much as duration.

item.title: Are Apple Watch sleep stages accurate?
item.description: Consumer watch stage charts look precise. Against lab sleep, they are estimates. Duration is the sturdier signal.
